posts.zh:
dsh-theme-switch 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 主题切换：自动检测已安装的皮肤/主题，在设置页一键互斥切换，全部停用时回退官方默认外观，切换即时生效并跨重启保留。

posts.en:
dsh-theme-switch is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. One-click skin switching for DSH Web settings: auto-detects installed themes, keeps exactly one active at a time, and falls back to the official look when all are off. Changes apply instantly and survive restarts.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1e7bef8a5b543d3f7bf9.html
